title: test_kbdecide builds its temp repository from a hand-listed set of bl_ modules, so every new module breaks it
goal: _tools/test_kbdecide.py make_root copies every bl_*.py file (a glob) into its temp repository instead of a hand-listed tuple, so a new bl_ module needs no edit there; a test named make_root_copies_all_bl_modules plants a new bl_ file and sees it copied. Found twice by ST-fb2hxf6s and ST-aqpalijz.
notes: mac-fourth found a glob in test_kbdecide's make_root trips the testmap scan check (source_scans); derive the list another way (read bl_*.py names from the backlog.py import lines) or declare the scan.
